meta_data.base_class: find the lowest price within a city for a specific <consumer goods category products> - these categories refer to tangible retail products whose prices can be directly compared.

tool_template.name: lowest_price_<class>
tool_template.description: Returns the lowest price for a particular <class> within a given city.

city.description: The city where the <class> will be searched.

product_name.description: The <class> name for which the lowest price will be searched.

currency.description: The currency in which the price of the <class> should be returned.

include_taxes.description: Indicates whether the price should include applicable taxes for the <class>.

retailer_preference.description: Preferred retailer to consider when searching for the <class>.

discounts.description: Whether to consider discounted prices for the <class>.
